title: hylotelephium maximum subsp. scherfelii
intro: Hylotelephium maximum subsp. scherfelii, commonly known as Korean Sedum or Golden Sedum, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Crassulaceae. It is a succulent with thick, fleshy leaves that can be used for medicinal purposes, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving antioxidant defenses, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's potential to treat various health conditions, including wounds, infections, and oxidative stress-related disorders.
